subject: Request: Support & TAM Operational Workbook for Due Diligence
messages:
From: Alice Monroe <alice.monroe@globexfinancial.com>
To: soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@globexfinancial.com, raj.patel@globexfinancial.com
Date: Sat, 14 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: RFI: Support operations workbook and TAM coverage details

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the demo last week. As part of our vendor due diligence for managed inference services, our security and procurement teams have a short operational workbook to complete that focuses on TAM coverage, incident communications, escalation SLAs, on-call staffing and evidence of audit/log retention.

Can you provide the following at a minimum?
- Primary/secondary TAM coverage (names + escalation order)
- On-call rotation hours and holiday coverage cadence (US timezones)
- Incident severity definitions and target response/acknowledgement/mitigation timelines (P1/P2/P3)
- Channels used for P1 vs P2 notifications (PagerDuty, email, portal, phone) and example alert flows
- Post-incident reporting timeline and sample PIR (timeline to deliver RCA + remediation plan)
- Retention windows for audit logs and access logs and how customers can request exports

If you can send a draft playbook or workbook we can share internally that would speed review. Ideally we have something by EOD Monday so procurement can move to contract redlines.

Best,
Alice Monroe
Director, Vendor Risk – Globex Financial
Attachments: none
From: soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Monroe <alice.monroe@globexfinancial.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 14 Nov 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: RFI: Support operations workbook and TAM coverage details

Hi Alice —

Thank you, and great to connect. I've put together a short operational workbook that covers the items you listed and included a draft playbook and current TAM roster for Q4. Please find the two attachments: support_playbook_draft_v1.pdf and tam_roster_q4_2026.csv. Highlights below:

- TAM Coverage: Primary TAM is Marissa Cole (marissa_cole@redwood.ai), secondary is Karthik Iyer. We include a named backup and regional on-call for P1 escalations.
- Hours & Rotation: Support hours are 24x5 for US business-critical coverage; P1 on-call rotation is 24x7 for P1s via our global on-call pool (US/EU/APAC overlap). Holidays are covered by the on-call pool with a 1:4 rotation.
- Severity & SLAs:
  - P1 (Service Down/Production Blocker): Acknowledge within 15 minutes, initial mitigation plan within 1 hour, full response/update cadence every hour until resolved.
  - P2 (Partial outage/degraded performance): Acknowledge within 1 hour, mitigation plan within 4 hours.
  - P3 (Minor issue/feature request): Acknowledge within 8 business hours.
- Notification Channels: P1s use PagerDuty + SMS + secure customer portal alerts; P2 uses portal + email; P3 uses email/ticketing. We can provide PagerDuty instance IDs and sample alert flows on request.
- Post-Incident Reporting: PIR delivered within 72 hours for P1s (initial RCA summary) and full RCA within 7 business days with remediation timeline.
- Log Retention: Audit logs retained 13 months by default; customer export via secure S3 transfer or encrypted Drive link on request (compliant with our retention policy).

I'm looping in Marissa and Karthik to confirm the roster details and to surface any compliance evidence we should attach (SOC artifacts, audit extracts). If that works, I'll update the workbook with any requested details and send a final version Monday EOD.

Best regards,
Soojin Lee
Senior Manager, Customer Operations
Redwood Inference
Attachments: support_playbook_draft_v1.pdf; tam_roster_q4_2026.csv
From: soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>

Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 10:33:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: RFI: Support operations workbook and TAM coverage details — action items

Team — forwarding Globex's request and the draft playbook I sent. Quick asks before I finalize the workbook:

1) Marissa: please confirm the primary/secondary TAM lines and the escalation order for P1s (include on-call phone numbers redacted if needed).
2) Karthik: procurement will likely ask for list of SLAs and refundable credits — can you draft the sample SLA exhibit language we typically use for enterprise deals (acknowledgement and mitigation timelines + credit calculation)?
3) Neha: can you pull the most recent SOC 2 evidence summary and any audit log extract showing retention policy? If a sanitized sample export is available, attach it (no customer data).

Target: I want a consolidated workbook by Mon 16 Nov 5pm PST. I'll add the PagerDuty service link and a short alert flow diagram (hosted in Drive).

Thanks — please reply inline with confirmations.

---
Soojin Lee
Senior Manager, Customer Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Alice Monroe <alice.monroe@globexfinancial.com>
To: soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: raj.patel@globexfinancial.com, procurement@globexfinancial.com
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 15:48:00 -0800
Subject: Re: RFI: Support operations workbook and TAM coverage details

Soojin —

Appreciate the quick turn. The draft playbook looks good overall and answers most questions. A few clarifications before we move to procurement redlines:

- Can you confirm whether audit log exports can be scheduled as recurring monthly exports (we'd like automated monthly exports to our secure S3)?
- For the P1 PIR: will the 72-hour summary include root cause hypothesis + customer-impact timeline, or is it a higher-level summary with the full RCA later? We want the 72-hour deliverable to be actionable for our incident review board.
- Can you provide an example of the PagerDuty incident webhook payload we would receive (we need the payload structure to integrate with our SOAR tooling)?

If you can answer these three items and attach the SOC 2 evidence summary, procurement can proceed to draft the Master Services Agreement and SOW. We are targeting a signed SOW by the end of the month pending legal review.

Thanks — look forward to the updated workbook and the webhook sample.

Best,
Alice Monroe
Director, Vendor Risk – Globex Financial
Attachments: none
